reference_method: Official walking task uses additive root velocity pushes, with per-axis range -0.3 to 0.3 m/s at training intervals of 3 to 6 s.
proposed_scope: Fixed mild perturbation after completion of the roll and landing windows, during the already active forward part of the same episode. Roll-phase disturbances and parameter randomization require their own gates.
invariants: Use the original start, roll, landing and 1000 forward controls. Preserve the original 116/128 full sequence gate in each role, including all pre-push samples.
Share a verified fork at the end of the common roll and landing budget, with the candidate feedback multiplier unchanged at 0.15 rad/s and maximum joint correction unchanged at 0.03 rad.

At the fork apply at most one additive horizontal velocity delta, directed left or right using the current world yaw; leave vertical and angular velocity, orientation, joints, delay queues and controller memory untouched.

Require the independently recomputed first-order velocity readback, exact observation boundary, one initial reset and no extra dynamics from filming. Compare all first-episode outcomes; record sign-specific paired changes and complete or partial original footage.

For proposed post-push recovery, require uninterrupted active state and valid joints for two seconds. Apply the original one-second planar speed-error and signed forward-speed bounds to the second second. At least 116 complete first episodes per role must also meet this recovery criterion. Freeze only after the nominal archive passes this added screen.
